name: Envenomed Lock (BB)

source.title: Pathfinder Beginner Box: Secrets of the Unlit Star

disable: DC 17 Thievery check on the spring mechanism

items.name: Spring
items.text: When a creature tries to unlock or Pick the Lock, a spine extends to attack that creature with a Spine attack.

text: A spring-loaded, poisoned spine is hidden near the keyhole of a lock. Disabling or breaking the trap doesn't disable or break the lock.
